name: What factors affect the cost of basement drywall finishing?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of basement drywall finishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall finishing costs for a basement depend on square footage, ceiling height, wall layouts, and the chosen finish level. Complex basement layouts with multiple partitioned rooms, closets, soffits enclosing ductwork, and structural post wraps require significantly more cutting, taping, and corner beading than open recreational rooms. Labor costs also reflect the existing framing condition, as bowed or out-of-plumb studs require shimming before hanging sheets to ensure flat finished walls. Combining drywall hanging, taping, texturing, and interior painting under a single finish contractor can help control overall project expenses by eliminating trade handoffs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on basement square footage, the number of divided rooms, soffits around ductwork, framing straightness, and whether you request custom textures.
